set.game.songcore_cache.desc: Game SongCore SongHashData.dat (empty = derived from root)

set.analysis.window_seconds.label: Time Window (s)
set.analysis.window_seconds.desc: (deprecated) Fixed time window width. Analysis is note-anchored now; kept only for old config.yaml compatibility
set.analysis.window_step_seconds.label: Sample Step (s)
set.analysis.window_step_seconds.desc: (deprecated) Fixed time window step. Analysis is note-anchored now; kept only for old config.yaml compatibility
set.analysis.slope_group_notes.label: Slope Group Size (notes)
set.analysis.slope_group_notes.desc: Granularity for fatigue slope & AI timeline: every N notes form one group (x = group median note time), then a per-minute linear slope is fit across groups. Smaller = more sensitive to local swings but noisier; larger = smoother trend — results can differ, choose by map density: fast maps ~30, sparse maps ~100. Default 50 (~10-15s of blocks)
set.analysis.fatigue_edge_seconds.label: Fatigue Edge (s)
set.analysis.fatigue_edge_seconds.desc: Early/late N seconds used for fatigue front-vs-back comparison
set.server.host.label: Listen Address
set.server.port.label: Port

set.ai.provider.desc: AI engine provider (off = disabled, rule-based report fallback)
set.ai.base_url.label: API Base URL
set.ai.base_url.desc: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (required for provider=custom)
set.ai.model.label: Model
set.ai.api_key.label: API Key
set.ai.api_key.desc: AI API key (stored in .env, masked in UI)
set.ai.temperature.label: Temperature
set.ai.max_tokens.label: Max Tokens
set.ai.max_tokens.desc: LLM max reply tokens per request
set.ai.ai_report_enabled.label: Use AI for Reports
set.ai.ai_report_enabled.desc: When checked, report generation calls the LLM (an API key is required); when unchecked, the deterministic rule-based report is used instead (no AI calls, saves quota)
set.network.proxy.label: Proxy
set.network.timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (s)
fatigue.note: Note: fatigue findings are kinematic proxies consistent with local fatigue, not a medical diagnosis.
reversal.hint: Fail concentration >1 = failures skew to fast segments ('can't keep up' signal); speed retention <1 = slower swings in fast segments.
history.title: History
compare.title: Compare
compare.desc: Compare metrics of two plays (B − A)
compare.hint: Note: Center/Pre/Post/accuracy higher is better; miss/bad/cut distance lower is better. Colors follow 'better for performance'.
scoresaber.title: ScoreSaber
scoresaber.validating: Comparing local parsed scores vs ScoreSaber records…
scoresaber.diff_hint: Non-zero diffs usually mean: ScoreSaber keeps the best score while local Replay is one specific play; or the score used a modifier.
scoresaber.no_overlap: No overlap between local Replays and recent ScoreSaber scores (normal: SS keeps only the best per map).
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.desc: UI display language (the page refreshes immediately after switching)
settings.game.title: Game Path
settings.game.desc: Select the Beat Saber install root; the app automatically derives map, Replay and SongCore relative paths (no manual input needed for standard installs). Validated on selection, saved on success.
settings.game.placeholder: No game root selected — click the button or type the path…
settings.game.browser_mode: Browser mode cannot open the native folder dialog; please type the game root manually
settings.game.invalid_structure: This directory does not match the Beat Saber structure (needs game root with a CustomLevels folder); please pick another.
settings.storage.title: SABER LAB Storage
settings.storage.desc: After clearing the analysis cache, all analysis data and AI reports must be recomputed (on demand). Original Replay files and the map library are untouched.
settings.restart_title: Game path applies immediately; port/AI changes need a restart
